login.subtitleSetup: First time using llamapad — please set an admin password
login.ruleMix: Mixing letters and digits is recommended
login.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
login.adminExists: Admin already exists, please sign in directly
login.requestFailed: Request failed, please try again later
login.networkError: Network error, please check the panel service and retry

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Runtime overview: GPU memory and utilization trends, container / inference metrics, disk usage and event log stream.
overview.chartsDescription: GPU memory & utilization, container CPU / memory and inference tok/s trends will arrive together with monitoring.
overview.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
overview.idleHint: Single model at a time: pick a model to start from the models list; starting a new one stops the current one.
overview.idleEmptyHint: Create a model configuration on the models page first (or wait for the M2 download wizard), then start it from here.

models.title: Models
models.description: Model configuration list and status management: status, name, quantization, size and actions, with parameter editing and a creation wizard.
models.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
models.emptyDescription: Create a model via the API (POST /api/v1/models), or wait for the M2 download wizard to download models from Hugging Face.
models.footnote: Single model at a time: starting a model stops the current one · Quant labels are detected from file names

moveDialog.title: Move model to a namespace
moveDialog.moveFilesHint: Moves the GGUF shard group (including mmproj) into the target namespace directory and rewrites the configured paths
moveDialog.hint: By default only the grouping changes and files stay put: cross-namespace references are expressed in the GGUF path and the model still starts.
moveDialog.errorRunning: Model is running: moving is blocked. Stop it first
moveDialog.errorNotFound: Model not found; it may have been deleted
moveDialog.errorBadRequest: Target namespace does not exist, or is the same as the current one
moveDialog.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
moveDialog.errorNetwork: Network error, check the panel service and retry

modelEdit.title: Edit model
modelEdit.namespaceHint: Changing the namespace only regroups the entry; files are not moved. Cross-namespace references are expressed in the GGUF path
modelEdit.ggufHint: Relative to the models root; shard globs supported (e.g. main/Qwen-*-00001-of-00002.gguf)
modelEdit.mmprojHint: Optional vision projector for multimodal models; leave empty for none
modelEdit.previewSubtitle: Final launch parameters merged from defaults and overrides
modelEdit.previewSummary: {count} overrides · restart the model after saving to apply
modelEdit.previewInvalid: Current input failed validation; preview shows defaults merged: {message}
modelEdit.dangerDescription: Removes only the configuration record (including overrides); GGUF files stay on disk.
modelEdit.dangerConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone; model files are not deleted.
modelEdit.errorConflict: Model is running: editing and deletion are blocked. Stop it first
modelEdit.errorNotFound: Model not found; it may have been deleted
modelEdit.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
modelEdit.errorNetwork: Network error, please check the panel service and retry

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.description: Model download management: task progress / speed / shard details, resumable transfers with sha256 verification, mirror sources and history.
downloads.retryTitle: Re-download this file from the model's download config (single-file semantics, no other files in the group)
downloads.errorTaskNotFound: Task not found: it may have just finished or been cleaned up
downloads.errorModelNotFound: Model not found; it may have been deleted
downloads.errorConflict: An unfinished task for the same file already exists; resolve the queue first
downloads.errorNoSource: Model has no download source configured
downloads.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
downloads.errorNetwork: Network error, check the panel service and retry
downloads.emptyDescription: Pick a Hugging Face repo or enter a direct URL in the new model wizard to download GGUF files; active tasks appear here with pause, resume and cancel support.

files.title: Files
files.description: Browse GGUF files: disk usage overview, directory tree + file table, with move / delete actions on selection.
files.lockedTooltip: Referenced by the running model, locked; stop the model before deleting
files.deleteSimpleDescription: The file is not referenced by any config and will be permanently removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
files.deleteReferencedWarning: This file is referenced by {count} configs:
files.forceLabel: I understand: these configs will lose the reference (the models cannot start until re-configured or re-downloaded)
files.siblingsHint: {count} sibling shard files remain in the same group; only the selected one is deleted (no group delete).
files.errorLocked: File is referenced by the running model and locked; stop the model first
files.errorReferenced: File is still referenced by configs (references may have changed); please re-check
files.errorNotFound: File not found; it may have been deleted
files.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
files.errorNetwork: Network error, check the panel service and retry
files.emptyDescription: GGUF files will appear here after download: check size, reference count and modification time; deletions always check config references and the running lock first.
files.emptyMissingHint: Directory does not exist: check the path mapping (paths.models.panel) in panel.yaml and the Docker mounts.
files.rootHint: Paths are relative to the models root · panel view {panel} ↔ host {host} (panel.yaml paths.models)

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Real-time monitoring: GPU / container / inference metric cards with sparklines and a full-width terminal log stream.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Built-in chat debugging: talks to the local inference service directly to validate model parameters and output.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Panel settings: namespace management, account security and panel preferences.
settings.nsDescription: Model groups (top-level models directories) · creating only adds the record; the directory appears when files land in it
settings.nsDeleteBlockedHint: This namespace still holds {count} model configs; move or delete them first
settings.nsRenameDescription: The directory on disk and every model config in this namespace move to the new name; rejected while a model in it is running.
settings.nsDeleteDescription: Removes only the panel record; the directory and files stay on disk and can be cleaned up on the files page.
settings.createErrorInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens are allowed
settings.errorConflict: Rejected: duplicate name, or a model in this namespace is running
settings.errorNotFound: Namespace not found; it may have been deleted
settings.errorRequest: Request failed, please try again later
settings.errorNetwork: Network error, check the panel service and retry
settings.accountDescription: Admin password changes and API token management.
settings.prefsDescription: Panel-level preferences such as default runtime parameters, UI and language.
